input.rationale: Article 12 contains mutual indemnities, but SFJ's indemnity (12.1.1(a)-(f)) is confined to its gross negligence/wilful misconduct, breaches of the Agreement, Protocol and AZ License and post-Program-Transfer trial and product liability; it says nothing about third-party intellectual-property infringement. Conversely, PB's indemnity at 12.1.2(f) covers infringement claims caused by "either Party" in performing its duties, so PB carries a one-way IP indemnity that also protects SFJ for SFJ's own conduct. That fails the fallback (no Vendor IP indemnity) and sits at the walk-away line. We therefore add a reciprocal SFJ IP indemnity at the fallback level, with the customary modification/combination/specification exclusions, procure-modify-replace-refund remedies and a 3x annual super-cap (scoped to the new indemnity so SFJ's existing uncapped indemnities are unaffected), narrow 12.1.2(f) to PB's own performance to remove the circularity, and conform the 12.2.1 procedure cross-reference so notice, control of defence and cooperation apply to the new indemnity.

proposal.summary: Add SFJ third-party IP indemnity (with standard exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and 3x annual super-cap) and conform PB's IP indemnity and the procedure cross-reference.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] SFJ's indemnity omits third-party IP infringement entirely while PB currently indemnifies SFJ for infringement caused by either Party's performance, so we add a reciprocal SFJ IP indemnity at our fallback (customary modification/combination/specification exclusions, procure-modify-replace-refund remedies and a 3x annual super-cap) and limit PB's IP indemnity to PB's own performance.

ops.text: 12.1.3 Third Party Intellectual Property. SFJ will indemnify and hold the PB Indemnified Parties harmless from any and all Losses arising or resulting from any Claim by a Third Party alleging that the performance by SFJ, its Affiliates or any of its or their respective Permitted Third Parties of SFJ's obligations under this Agreement, or any materials, technology or methods supplied by SFJ hereunder, infringes or misappropriates such Third Party's Intellectual Property, except to the extent the alleged infringement arises from (i) modifications made by or for PB, (ii) combination of the affected item with items not supplied by SFJ, or (iii) specifications furnished by PB. If any such item is or may become the subject of such a Claim, SFJ will procure for PB the right to continue using the affected item, or will modify or replace it so that it becomes non-infringing, and if none of the foregoing is commercially reasonable, SFJ will refund the amounts paid by PB to SFJ for the affected item. SFJ's aggregate liability under this Section 12.1.3 will not exceed three times the aggregate Approval Payments paid or payable by PB to SFJ in the twelve (12) months preceding the Claim.
